chains.name: gen0
chains.description: Generation 0 from height 0, with a genesis of unequal powers that exercises CometBFT's arithmetic (an Etna genesis gives each fallback key power 1, as in fallback_genesis_to_candidate): every single-height increment through 48, and updates returned at 6 (add), 13 (remove), 20 (re-weight), 27 (add, remove and re-weight at once), 34 (add), 41 (replace the largest member) and 48 (re-weight), each signing from two heights later. Equal powers order by address; ties go to the lower address.

chains.name: gen1
chains.description: Generation 1 from governance recovery at c = 48 (8.4): a new genesis at 48 with other members of unequal powers and initial height 49. Generation 0's update returned at 48 is discarded with the rest of its state; the update returned at 55 (add one member, remove another) signs from 57.

chains.name: bounds_a
chains.description: The update returned at 2 leaves a priority spread of exactly 2·total, so neither UpdateWithChangeSet nor IncrementProposerPriority rescales; the increment raises it to 2·total + 1, so height 3 rescales by 2 and then centers a sum of -1 by floor(-1 / 4) = -1, leaving the largest residual sum, n - 1.

chains.name: bounds_b
chains.description: Height 3 rescales a spread of 2·total + 1 left by the update returned at 2; the update returned at 5 leaves a spread of 2·total + 1 inside UpdateWithChangeSet, whose rescale truncates negative priorities toward zero.

chains.name: bounds_c
chains.description: Three members of equal power: genesis and later increments break priority ties by address. Height 3 has no update and increments a set whose spread is exactly 2·total, which is not rescaled.

chains.name: fallback_genesis_to_candidate
chains.description: Generation 0 as Etna derives it from S = 0: the genesis is the origin's fallback key set, c1..c4 at power 1 each, which signs 1 and 2. FinalizeBlock(1) switches to a usable candidate (c5 at 30, c6 at 20, c7 at 10) with one list that also removes every fallback key, so the candidate signs from 3. A stake change re-weights c6 to 25 at 4 (signing from 6) and an exit removes c7 at 6 (from 8). At 8 the candidate is no longer usable, and one list replaces it with the fallback key set at power 1, which signs from 10.

chains.name: recovery_origin_keys
chains.description: Generation 1 from governance recovery at c = 10 (8.4): a new genesis at 10 with initial height 11, whose validators are the new origin's fallback keys, c8 and c9 at power 1; they sign 11 and 12. FinalizeBlock(11) replaces them with a usable candidate, c5 at 30, in one list, and the candidate signs from 13.

max_committee.description: 128 members, the most that any set that signs a block has, at CometBFT's MaxTotalVotingPower: genesis at 0 and one increment. Member i (0 <= i < 128) is key mi with private key 0x10000 + i; its power is 2^48 + (i mod 64) - 32 for i < 127, and member 127 takes the rest of the total, 3969·2^48 + 94. Only the hash and the first and last rows of each set are listed.

enc_a_23b_a.description: data is 28 bytes of 0xff, so its last byte is round 0's x

enc_a_23c_b.description: data is 130,044 bytes of 0xff: the length bytes are 01 fb fc, no fill

enc_a_23d_f.description: the blob of 23c.a with byte 0 changed from 0x00 to 0x40: it does not decode
